clue.text: Saying that you've seen worse might be, if grant-maintained whips get organised

definitions.text: Saying that you've seen worse might be

indicators.note: to get organised is to be put into a new order, so the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark about state-funded schools whose disciplinary officials finally sort themselves out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grant-maintained' was a category of British state school; 'whips' looks like a political noun. All twenty-two letters of IF GRANT-MAINTAINED WHIPS are reshuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Grudging praise such as 'I've seen worse' is a backhanded way of condemning something, which is exactly what the phrase describes.
